id: c1d4e7a2-5b62-4f18-8a90-77e3b1c2f6d0
description: Detects an interpreter spawned by the GitHub Actions Runner.Worker process reading /proc/<pid>/mem to extract secrets from runner memory, matching TeamPCP's trivy-action credential stealer.

  product: linux

      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/node'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/proc/'
      - 'mem'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd

title: Miasma v2 binding.gyp dropped into known-compromised npm package path
id: 9a82d401-77c5-4e0a-b1bd-5c8e6f2a90d3
description: Detects binding.gyp file writes inside node_modules subdirectories of the publicly named Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp victims, which historically did not ship native add-ons
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://www.chainguard.dev/unchained/chainguard-artifacts-safe-from-miasma-phantom-gyp-npm-attack
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  filename:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\binding.gyp'
      - '/binding.gyp'
  victim_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'node_modules\@vapi-ai\server-sdk'
      - 'node_modules/@vapi-ai/server-sdk'
      - 'node_modules\ai-sdk-ollama'
      - 'node_modules/ai-sdk-ollama'
      - 'node_modules\@redhat-cloud-services'
      - 'node_modules/@redhat-cloud-services'
  condition: filename and victim_path
falsepositives:
  - A legitimate post-incident fixed version of these packages reintroducing a clean binding.gyp (verify SHA256 against published artifact)
level: high
3495.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="binding.gyp" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*node_modules*@vapi-ai*server-sdk*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*node_modules*ai-sdk-ollama*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*node_modules*@redhat-cloud-services*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_hash Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
3495.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR linux.auditd) @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*node_modules\\@vapi-ai\\server-sdk\\binding.gyp* OR *node_modules/@vapi-ai/server-sdk/binding.gyp* OR *node_modules\\ai-sdk-ollama\\binding.gyp* OR *node_modules/ai-sdk-ollama/binding.gyp* OR *node_modules\\@redhat-cloud-services\\*\\binding.gyp* OR *node_modules/@redhat-cloud-services/*/binding.gyp*)
3495.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/binding\.gyp$/i
| TargetFileName=/node_modules[\\\/](@vapi-ai[\\\/]server-sdk|ai-sdk-ollama|@redhat-cloud-services[\\\/])/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, WrittenBytes], function=count())

3496.sigma:
title: Miasma v2 Phantom Gyp payload SHA256 IOC match
id: 4e2c01a8-9f3b-4d97-8c1a-2f6e8e0a4d51
description: Hash hit for any of the four SHA256s associated with the Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp npm worm payload set
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/miasma-v2-self-spreading-npm-worm-now-uses-malicious-bindinggyp-file-and-compromises-57-packages/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Hashes|contains:
      - 'ef641e956f91d501b748085996303c96a64d67f63bfeef0dda175e5aa19cca90'
      - '288f26c2eadcb1a7923fe376d16f5404216cce15d9fc162a4a78574dc7df399a'
      - 'e3dbe63aded45278f49c4746ab938ed9472b36def79b43e2dd2d7eff014481d1'
      - 'ceff7c51d70832c3ec8dd2744b606a23b3c924ef664ae23439b9b742ea154108'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Forensic analysts intentionally staging the IOC sample on isolated lab hosts
  - Security tooling pre-loading detonation samples
level: critical

3497.def:
let gyp_node_children = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python.exe","python3.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash")
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("gyp.py","binding.gyp","node-gyp")
        or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("python.exe","python3.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcSpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("api.github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com",".workers.dev","webhook.site","ngrok.io","hooks.slack.com","discord.com/api/webhooks","transfer.sh","file.io","0x0.st")
   or RemoteIPType == "Public"
| join kind=inner gyp_node_children on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ProcessId
| where Timestamp between (ProcSpawnTime .. ProcSpawnTime + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, ProcessCommandLine=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, GypParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine1
| order by Timestamp desc
3497.sent:
let gyp_node_children = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)[\\/]node(\.exe)?$"
    | where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)[\\/](python3?|cmd|sh|bash)(\.exe)?$"
    | where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("gyp.py","binding.gyp","node-gyp")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ProcSpawnTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActingProcessId, ParentProcessCommandLine;
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where DstHostname has_any ("api.github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com",".workers.dev","webhook.site","ngrok.io","hooks.slack.com","discord.com","transfer.sh","file.io","0x0.st")
| join kind=inner gyp_node_children on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (ProcSpawnTime .. ProcSpawnTime + 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, SrcUsername, DstHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkBytes, ParentProcessCommandLine
3497.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python.exe","python3.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash") AND (Processes.parent_process="*gyp*" OR Processes.parent_process="*binding.gyp*" OR Processes.parent_process="*node-gyp*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_id Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process Processes._time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename _time as proc_time process_id as suspect_pid | join type=inner dest suspect_pid [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="api.github.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="raw.githubusercontent.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.workers.dev" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.webhook.site" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.ngrok.io" OR All_Traffic.dest="hooks.slack.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="discord.com") AND All_Traffic.app="node.exe" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as dest dest as net_dest app as suspect_pid]
3497.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR crowdstrike) @EventID:3 @Image:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE) (@DestinationHostname:(*api.github.com* OR *raw.githubusercontent.com* OR *.workers.dev OR *webhook.site* OR *ngrok.io* OR *hooks.slack.com* OR *discord.com* OR *transfer.sh* OR *file.io* OR *0x0.st*))
3497.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\node\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/^(python3?|cmd|sh|bash)\.exe$/i ParentCommandLine=/(gyp\.py|binding\.gyp|node-gyp)/i
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(api\.github\.com|raw\.githubusercontent\.com|objects\.githubusercontent\.com|\.workers\.dev$|webhook\.site|ngrok\.io|hooks\.slack\.com|discord\.com|transfer\.sh|file\.io|0x0\.st)/i}, field=aid, include=[DomainName, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, DomainName, CommandLine, ParentCommandLine], function=count())

3498.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Miasma npm Supply Chain Attack: Self-Spreading Worm via Phantom Gyp
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3498.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Miasma npm Supply Chain Attack: Self-Spreading Worm via Phantom Gyp ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("index.js","node.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("index.js","node.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
